title: Delete Part shows only on an existing part, to a user with Delete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in at the test location as user B, whose role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start in both browsers on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In browser 1, click New Inventory Part.
  2. In browser 1, click Cancel.
  3. In browser 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  4. In browser 1, click the part A row.
  5. In browser 1, click Cancel.
  6. In browser 2, as user B, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  7. In browser 2, click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part footer shows only Cancel and Save: there is no Delete Part.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 4:

  • The Edit Inventory Part footer shows Delete Part at the left, with Cancel and Save at the right.

Step 5:

  • The window closes.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed in browser 2.

Step 7:

  • User B sees Cancel and Save in the footer and no Delete Part button.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S13-R10: “Delete Part is shown only when editing, to a user with the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S8-R12: “Delete Part in the part dialog requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission. Without it the button is not shown.”
